books.title: Clean Code
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.description: A practical guide to writing readable, maintainable software through clear naming, focused functions, and disciplined design.
books.summary: Best for developers who already know basic programming and want to improve code quality in real projects.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: A practical system for building better habits, breaking bad ones, and improving a little every day.
books.summary: Useful for readers who want a clear, step-by-step method for changing daily behavior.

books.title: The  Programmer
books.author: Thomas and Andrew
books.description: Timeless advice for software developers about craftsmanship, debugging, automation, and professional growth.
books.summary: A strong general-purpose programming book for building better habits as a professional developer.

books.title: The Design
books.author: Don Norman
books.description: An influential introduction to user-centered design, affordances, feedback, and why everyday products succeed or fail.
books.summary: Recommended for anyone designing products, interfaces, tools, or physical objects.

books.title: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.description: A focused look at how distraction-free concentration helps people produce valuable, meaningful work.
books.summary: A practical read for students, developers, and knowledge workers who want better focus.

books.title: Algorithms
books.author: Thomas H. Cormen
books.description: A comprehensive reference for algorithm design and analysis, covering data structures, graph algorithms, sorting, and more.
books.summary: A deep academic reference for computer science students and engineers preparing for advanced algorithm work.
